requirements.description: Raw SEC EDGAR 10-K filings and filing metadata for FY 1995–2013 text outcomes, same-year boilerplate universe and prior-year sticky-text comparison.

required_coverage.population: All public U.S. issuer 10-K filings forming the same-year boilerplate universe, plus prior-year filings for sample firms.
required_coverage.detail: The sample fiscal-year range is 1996–2013; sticky-word construction needs prior fiscal year 1995 for the first sample year. Filing date and fiscal year are not identical; broad filing-year envelope 1996–2014 is required.

routes.mapping_notes: Directory existence only; local SEC document contents, filing years and coverage have not been read.
routes.coverage_notes: The authorized directory probe establishes the documented path only; it did not test document contents, historical years, sample inclusion, or identifiers.

routes.mapping_notes: SEC index records identify CIK, form type, filing date and path to the complete raw filing. Filing-year access is supported; mapping the target FY sample and processing rules remains a separate step.
routes.coverage_notes: SEC official documentation reports public filing indexes from 1994Q3 onward and raw complete disseminated filing paths; this exceeds the 1996–2014 filing-year envelope but does not establish the paper’s selection or fiscal-year join.

requirements.description: Compustat annual firm-year assets, intangibles, market equity, book equity, leverage, net income, auditor and listing fields for controls, filters and Compustat age.

required_coverage.population: U.S. Compustat firms matched to 10-K filings; baseline fiscal years 1996–2013 and complete pre-sample Compustat history for age since first listing.
required_coverage.detail: Current-year accounting/prices and selection use 1996–2013; Age reaches the earliest available Compustat observation for each firm, which is not bounded by the paper’s sample start.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No local coverage confirmation establishes 1996–2013 fields or full pre-sample history needed for Compustat age; exact mappings remain unverified.

routes.mapping_notes: Exact current annual fields are probed; fixed-1996-dollar adjustment, item mappings, historical age and source-vintage equivalence remain unverified.
routes.coverage_notes: No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for these required years, populations or frequencies. Probe rows/columns do not establish coverage.

requirements.description: CRSP historical exchange code and firm identifiers for the NYSE indicator (EXCHCD 1 or 2) and stock filters.

routes.coverage_notes: No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for these required years, populations or frequencies. Probe rows/columns do not establish coverage.

requirements.description: Compustat segment records for annual business- and geographic-segment counts.

routes.mapping_notes: Current segment columns are probed; source/type code mapping, segment-count rule and year coverage are not confirmed.
routes.coverage_notes: No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for these required years, populations or frequencies. Probe rows/columns do not establish coverage.

requirements.description: Historical CIK-to-GVKEY link intervals matching each SEC 10-K to Compustat fiscal-year data.

requirements.description: Price index used to express Compustat assets in constant 1996 dollars.
